ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 80% high-intensity white surface area bounded by a 20% low-intensity black perimeter and interior focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity central lobes; low-intensity (black) contiguous band along the trailing edge and tips; localized low-intensity circular blobs scattered across the mid-left lobe; large dark triangular region at the basal insertion point.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 70-75 degrees and significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-serrations with 2-5 pixel amplitudes along the entire trailing boundary; most pronounced jaggedness at the distal tips and adjacent to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the distal tips inward to the median notch; leading edge (top in frame) displays a slight convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete, roughly circular low-intensity clusters on the mid-to-lower left lobe, ranging from 5 to 15 pixels in diameter.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, single diagonal low-intensity linear mark observed on the lower interior quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular pixel loss and jagged fragmentation at both distal tips; prominent dark pigmentation intrusion at the fluke-to-peduncle junction area.
